```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
set.seed(2025)
```

```{r import}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

# Read in the raw data
data_path <- "../data_raw"
files <- list.files(data_path, full.names = TRUE)
raw <- files %>%
  map_dfr(read_csv, .id = "file_id")

# Filter out survey-text rows and select relevant columns
anonymized <- raw %>%
  filter(trial_type != "survey-text") %>%  # remove survey-text rows
  select(
    sentence,
    type,
    verb,
    context,
    response,
    factP,
    person,
    item,
    participantID
  ) %>%
  # Anonymize participantID
  mutate(participantID = factor(participantID),        # ensure unique IDs are recognized
         participantID = paste0("P", as.integer(participantID)))  # assign P1, P2, ...

```
```{r}
write_csv(anonymized, "../anonymized_data.csv")
```
